design_description: A Morocco-inspired red and green kit with a subtle geometric pattern running tone-on-tone across the entire jersey. The bright red base is contrasted by deep green collar and sleeve trim, directly referencing the Moroccan colour palette. The pattern uses interlocking Moroccan-style geometric forms, kept understated so the shirt remains clean. White numbers provide strong contrast, with small green star details incorporated into the back. The shorts reverse the balance with a solid green base and thin red side stripes, tying naturally into the jersey. Overall, Tiki-Tajine FC has a clean Moroccan identity, combining traditional geometric influence with a modern football aesthetic.
